unreleased_features: timeline.select accepts linked:false to select one member of a linked pair; absent from v0.8.0.
Command discovery includes search keywords beyond the v0.9.0 catalog.
Recorded layer.select actions can use layer name and occurrence for portable targeting.
Control authentication has an absolute 10-second deadline.
MCP --automation-read-root and --automation-write-root; v0.8.0 supports --root but not these separate flags.
run --script --report produces one JSON report.
text_word_count, filtered/paginated accessibility_tags, and expanded accessibility tools.
CLI page lists support ranges such as extract --pages 1,3,5-8.
Headless MCP --automation-read-root and --automation-write-root; absent from v0.8.0 and incompatible with --connect.
Native ime tool and expanded new_document options including intent, units, startPage, slug and primaryTextFrame.
MCP command parameter validation rejects unknown keys and prevalidates batch steps.
Script result references preserve non-reference dollar strings and use $$ for a literal dollar.
Bridge requests are not replayed automatically after a lost response; inspect uncertain edits before retrying.
CLI run/exec returns exit 1 for a failed renderQueue.render.
CLI render honors --empty. The audited main declares 0.11.0, but the latest published release is v0.10.0.
render --settings accepts one .lcpreset or XMP preset, not a preset collection.
merge hdr-batch / merge.hdrBatch returns per-stack merged and failed results.
Slideshow layout, templates, preview and PDF/JPEG/AV1 export with activity progress and cancellation.
library.recheckPreviewOnly rechecks RAW support while preserving adjustments and history.
photo.readFocusPoints and meta.focus expose camera focus metadata.
doc_inspect / inspect_document support ids, kind, limit and offset beyond v0.12.0.
Native MCP supports cancellation, progress tokens and busy error -32003 beyond v0.12.0.
